verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say Server Pro adds a management API alongside the web console, device groups, address book, access control and audit logs. That is a first-party API, but the only evidence is a single line in llms.txt, and nothing shows it matches what the UI can do. It also appears limited to the paid Pro server, not the OSS server or the client. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, evidence of API coverage matching the UI (sessions, file transfer, settings, address book), an API in the free/OSS edition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
